timing: After all second-round DEV results, before third-round DEV results and final Navtest sampling. This is not a blind initial preregistration.
exact_export_and_config_duplicates: Reuse one sealed evaluation, retaining explicit alias identity and zero-new-work accounting.
selection_rule: Use the existing original_export/SELECTION_RULE.json with the user's single_seed_override; require completed single-seed original DEV, NC/DAC/TTC mean nondegradation, fixed-reference-safe component/joint violation counts not increased and positive mean PDMS gain. Highest eligible PDMS wins; exact ties use sorted checkpoint name. Otherwise retain SFT.
purpose: Confirm the four matched online endpoints and separately the finite-DEV-qualified checkpoint. Fixed-bank P0/P1/P2 endpoints remain fully reported on DEV; do not add every intermediate checkpoint to Navtest.
resource_routing: Separate current-capacity routing on the four authorized Tsinghua hosts; no host or shard index enters scene noise. Preserve Base/G/IQE work.
historical_Navtest_exposure: Repeatedly observed in earlier research; not a fully blind benchmark.
